remarks:
Sustainable Living, Breathtaking Sunsets & 50.4 Acres of Country Beauty! Discover the freedom of wide-open spaces and energy-independent living at this exceptional 2007-built ranch, featuring a wind turbine and smart solar panel system that have little to no utility costs! Two drilled wells and on-site septic systems add to its self-sufficient appeal.
A private driveway leads to a striking brick-front home crowned by a gorgeous copper-toned metal roof. Inside, natural light pours through beautiful windows into warm, inviting living spaces. The spacious kitchen offers rich wood cabinetry, abundant counter space, pantry storage and a breakfast bar. Gather in the formal dining room or enjoy cozy evenings beside the living room fireplace. Three generous bedrooms include a primary suite with private bath and walk-in closet, complemented by a full guest bath, half bath and dedicated laundry room with additional storage. 
The impressive 2,100 sq. ft. full basement features a finished recreation room, tremendous storage and convenient access from both the home and attached three-car garage. Expansive unfinished space above the garage offers exciting possibilities for future use. 
Outdoors, a 24' x 36' horse barn with rubber flooring, water and electric, along with an additional 26' x 36' barn, provides incredible flexibility for equestrian pursuits, farming, equipment or hobbies. Hot water heat adds to the home's comfort. 
From peaceful mornings watching the sunrise over rolling farmland to breathtaking sunsets painting the evening sky, every day offers something extraordinary. Whether you envision a working farm, sustainable homestead, equestrian retreat or simply a private country escape, this remarkable property delivers the space, freedom and versatility to bring your vision to life. Opportunities offering this combination of acreage, sustainability and amenities are truly special and a rare opportunity.
